title: 第18课 · 我相信他们会同意的
subtitle: HSK 3 · Lesson 18 — 我相信他们会同意的 · I believe they'll agree

data.topic: 课文1 · 1. 在打电话 — On the phone

items.zh: 向
items.py: xiàng
items.en: towards

items.zh: 万
items.py: wàn
items.en: ten thousand

items.zh: 朋友：老周，我打算买房子了，想向你借点儿钱。
items.py: Péngyou: Lǎo Zhōu, wǒ dǎsuàn mǎi fángzi le, xiǎng xiàng nǐ jiè diǎnr qián.
items.en: Friend: Old Zhou, I'm planning to buy a house and I'd like to borrow some money from you.

items.zh: 周明：没问题，只要我有，就一定会借给你的。还差多少？
items.py: Zhōu Míng: Méi wèntí, zhǐyào wǒ yǒu, jiù yīdìng huì jiè gěi nǐ de. Hái chà duōshao?
items.en: Zhou Ming: No problem — as long as I have it, I'll definitely lend it to you. How much are you short?

items.zh: 朋友：还差5万块钱。
items.py: Péngyou: Hái chà wǔ wàn kuài qián.
items.en: Friend: I'm still 50,000 yuan short.

items.zh: 周明：好，钱下午打给你。你打算在哪儿买房？
items.py: Zhōu Míng: Hǎo, qián xiàwǔ dǎ gěi nǐ. Nǐ dǎsuàn zài nǎr mǎi fáng?
items.en: Zhou Ming: OK, I'll transfer the money this afternoon. Where are you planning to buy?

items.zh: 朋友：就在我们医院前面。
items.py: Péngyou: Jiù zài wǒmen yīyuàn qiánmian.
items.en: Friend: Right in front of our hospital.

items.zh: 周明：那你以后去医院就方便了。
items.py: Zhōu Míng: Nà nǐ yǐhòu qù yīyuàn jiù fāngbiàn le.
items.en: Zhou Ming: Then it'll be convenient for you to get to the hospital from now on.

data.topic: 课文2 · 2. 在商店 — In a store

items.zh: 只
items.py: zhī
items.en: measure word for certain animals

items.zh: 嘴
items.py: zuǐ
items.en: mouth

items.zh: 动物
items.py: dòngwù
items.en: animal

items.zh: 段
items.py: duàn
items.en: measure word for sections or periods

items.zh: 小明：妈妈，你看那只狗多可爱，眼睛大大的，嘴小小的，我们买回去吧。
items.py: Xiǎomíng: Māma, nǐ kàn nà zhī gǒu duō kě'ài, yǎnjing dàdà de, zuǐ xiǎoxiǎo de, wǒmen mǎi huiqu ba.
items.en: Xiaoming: Mum, look how cute that dog is — big eyes, a little mouth. Let's buy it and take it home.

items.zh: 妈妈：动物和小孩儿一样，都需要人照顾。买回家去，谁照顾它啊？
items.py: Māma: Dòngwù hé xiǎoháir yīyàng, dōu xūyào rén zhàogù. Mǎi hui jiā qu, shéi zhàogù tā a?
items.en: Mum: Animals are like children — they need someone to look after them. If we buy it and take it home, who'll look after it?

items.zh: 小明：我照顾啊。
items.py: Xiǎomíng: Wǒ zhàogù a.
items.en: Xiaoming: I will!

items.zh: 妈妈：这段时间你自己的衣服都没洗，你能照顾好它吗？
items.py: Māma: Zhè duàn shíjiān nǐ zìjǐ de yīfu dōu méi xǐ, nǐ néng zhàogù hǎo tā ma?
items.en: Mum: Lately you haven't even washed your own clothes. Can you really take good care of it?

items.zh: 小明：只要你给我买，我就能照顾好它。
items.py: Xiǎomíng: Zhǐyào nǐ gěi wǒ mǎi, wǒ jiù néng zhàogù hǎo tā.
items.en: Xiaoming: As long as you buy it for me, I can take good care of it.

data.topic: 课文3 · 3. 在公司 — In the company

items.zh: 不但……而且……
items.py: búdàn……érqiě……
items.en: not only… but also…

items.zh: 有名
items.py: yǒumíng
items.en: famous

items.zh: 同意
items.py: tóngyì
items.en: to agree

items.zh: 相信
items.py: xiāngxìn
items.en: to believe

items.zh: 关于
items.py: guānyú
items.en: about, regarding

items.zh: 机会
items.py: jīhuì
items.en: opportunity

items.zh: 经理：说说你为什么选择来我们公司工作。
items.py: Jīnglǐ: Shuōshuo nǐ wèi shénme xuǎnzé lái wǒmen gōngsī gōngzuò.
items.en: Manager: Tell me why you chose to come and work at our company.

items.zh: 学生：贵公司不但很有名，而且工作环境好。
items.py: Xuésheng: Guì gōngsī bùdàn hěn yǒumíng, érqiě gōngzuò huánjìng hǎo.
items.en: Student: Your company is not only very famous, but also has a good working environment.

items.zh: 经理：做这个工作有点儿累，需要经常去外地。你家人同意吗？
items.py: Jīnglǐ: Zuò zhège gōngzuò yǒudiǎnr lèi, xūyào jīngcháng qù wàidì. Nǐ jiārén tóngyì ma?
items.en: Manager: This job is a bit tiring and you'll often need to travel to other places. Does your family agree?

items.zh: 学生：只要我愿意，我相信他们就会同意的。
items.py: Xuésheng: Zhǐyào wǒ yuànyì, wǒ xiāngxìn tāmen jiù huì tóngyì de.
items.en: Student: As long as I'm willing, I believe they'll agree.

items.zh: 经理：好，那你明天来上班吧。关于这个工作，还有什么问题吗？
items.py: Jīnglǐ: Hǎo, nà nǐ míngtiān lái shàng bān ba. Guānyú zhège gōngzuò, hái yǒu shénme wèntí ma?
items.en: Manager: Good, then start work tomorrow. Do you have any other questions about the job?

items.zh: 学生：没有了，谢谢您给我这个机会，我会努力的。
items.py: Xuésheng: Méiyǒu le, xièxie nín gěi wǒ zhège jīhuì, wǒ huì nǔlì de.
items.en: Student: No, thank you for giving me this opportunity. I'll work hard.

data.topic: 课文4 · 4. 短文 — Different cultures

items.zh: 国家
items.py: guójiā
items.en: country, nation

items.zh: 种
items.py: zhǒng
items.en: kind, type

items.zh: 特点
items.py: tèdiǎn
items.en: feature

items.zh: 奇怪
items.py: qíguài
items.en: strange, odd

items.zh: 地
items.py: de
items.en: particle linking an adverbial to the verb

items.zh: 不同的国家有不同的文化，每种文化都有自己的特点。
items.py: Bù tóng de guójiā yǒu bù tóng de wénhuà, měi zhǒng wénhuà dōu yǒu zìjǐ de tèdiǎn.
items.en: Different countries have different cultures, and every culture has its own features.

items.zh: 到了一个新环境，你会觉得什么都很新鲜，而且还会觉得有点奇怪：
items.py: Dào le yī ge xīn huánjìng, nǐ huì juéde shénme dōu hěn xīnxiān, érqiě hái huì juéde yǒudiǎn qíguài:
items.en: When you arrive in a new environment, everything feels fresh, and some things also seem a little strange:

items.zh: 有些国家的人名写在姓前面，有些国家的人名写在姓后面，但是只要经过一段时间，就会慢慢地习惯。
items.py: yǒuxiē guójiā de rénmíng xiě zài xìng qiánmian, yǒuxiē guójiā de rénmíng xiě zài xìng hòumian, dànshì zhǐyào jīngguò yī duàn shíjiān, jiù huì mànmàn de xíguàn.
items.en: in some countries the given name is written before the surname, in others after it — but as long as some time passes, you'll slowly get used to it.

items.zh: 只要我有时间，就一定跟你去旅游。
items.py: Zhǐyào wǒ yǒu shíjiān, jiù yīdìng gēn nǐ qù lǚyóu.
items.en: As long as I have time, I'll definitely go travelling with you.

items.zh: 我只要喜欢，就一定会买。
items.py: Wǒ zhǐyào xǐhuan, jiù yīdìng huì mǎi.
items.en: As long as I like it, I'll definitely buy it.

items.zh: 只要你想去，我就跟你去。
items.py: Zhǐyào nǐ xiǎng qù, wǒ jiù gēn nǐ qù.
items.en: As long as you want to go, I'll go with you.

items.zh: 只要你给我买，我就能照顾好它。
items.py: Zhǐyào nǐ gěi wǒ mǎi, wǒ jiù néng zhàogù hǎo tā.
items.en: As long as you buy it for me, I can take good care of it.

items.zh: 我最近看了一些关于中国文化的电影。
items.py: Wǒ zuìjìn kàn le yīxiē guānyú Zhōngguó wénhuà de diànyǐng.
items.en: Recently I've watched some films about Chinese culture.

items.zh: 关于这件事，我们还没有决定呢。
items.py: Guānyú zhè jiàn shì, wǒmen hái méiyǒu juédìng ne.
items.en: We haven't made a decision about this matter yet.

items.zh: 关于出国学习的事，妈妈已经同意了。
items.py: Guānyú chū guó xuéxí de shì, māma yǐjīng tóngyì le.
items.en: Mum has already agreed about studying abroad.

items.zh: 关于这个工作，还有什么问题吗？
items.py: Guānyú zhège gōngzuò, hái yǒu shénme wèntí ma?
items.en: Do you have any other questions about the job?

items.en: animal + park → zoo

items.en: person + name → personal name

items.py: zìjǐ + xiāngxìn → zìxìn
items.en: oneself + believe → self-confident
